name: integrix
description: Write integration in JAX on integrix — sums against a quadrature rule over one axis or several, band-weighted means, log-integrals, running integrals, adaptive Gauss–Kronrod, tanh–sinh and Romberg quadrature, Monte Carlo, quasi-Monte Carlo and importance-sampling expectations, fixed-step and IMEX time steppers that extend diffrax, and checkpointed or truncated adjoints — instead of re-implementing them with trapz, scipy.integrate and hand-written loops.
